rating.comments: The first message is the pasted task and was ignored. The student built a step-by-step count by digit length: "from 1 to 9 there are 9 numers that require 1 stroke each", then "there are 89 numbers and they would need 2 keystrokes each", then "from 100 to 999 there are 899 numbers requiring of 3 keystrokes each". The student applies the one-stroke-per-digit idea to longer numbers, but gives little justification and miscounts (89 instead of 90, 899 instead of 900). The student never asks a question and never gives a total for 1 to 1000.
